description: Load Lenny Zeltser's complete cybersecurity-writing rating toolkit: all 7 sheets, scoring policy, scoring playbook, and cross-references to the writing guidelines. This server never requests your draft and instructs your AI to keep it local—rating sheets and scoring instructions flow to your AI.

detail_level.description: minimal: sheet metadata + scoring playbook only (~2k tokens). standard: full sheets + scoring playbook + cross-references (~6k tokens, default). comprehensive: everything including related articles and errata (~9k tokens).

name: rating_load_context
